paragraphs: In Zevachim 38a Rava said: “Bar Ada Mari explained it to me.” Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Ada Mari.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Zevachim 38a paragraph has Rava crediting Bar Ada Mari with explaining the matter TO him. The Rav Ada Mari alternative remains Hyman’s report about Dikdukei Soferim, not a fresh apparatus collation or a replacement of BAR with RAV. No identity or additional legal teaching is admitted.
